title: Pipeline Run Configuration
description: Top-level entry point for any pipeline execution. Specifies input sources, phase control, debate settings, codebase context, knowledge base connections, and output configuration. Saved alongside artifacts for reproducibility.

id.description: Unique identifier for this pipeline run

pipeline_version.description: Version of pipeline.toml this run targets

created.description: Date this run config was created

RunInputs.description: Input sources for the pipeline run

documents.description: Local file paths or globs to ingest. Supports PDF, markdown, text, CSV, HTML, JSON, YAML, code files, and Jupyter notebooks.

documents_recursive.description: Whether to recursively scan directories in document paths

existing_collections.description: Paths to existing curated-collection JSON files to include (e.g., resume from prior run)

manifest.description: Path to an existing research-manifest file. If empty and discovery is enabled, a manifest is auto-generated from documents.

enabled.description: Whether to run the research discovery phase

augment_from_documents.description: When true and documents are provided: analyze ingested docs, auto-generate a research manifest with queries derived from document content, then run discovery to find additional related sources

merge_strategy.description: How to combine ingested documents with discovery results. 'append' merges into a single raw collection; 'separate' keeps as distinct collections.

auto_manifest.description: Settings for auto-generated manifests (used when augment_from_documents is true)

max_queries.description: Maximum number of auto-generated search queries

PhaseControl.description: Explicit phase control for this run

skip.description: Phases to skip. All other phases run if their DAG inputs are satisfied.

targets.description: Which artifact types to run debate on

max_rounds.description: Number of divergent-convergent cycles per debate

extra_specialists.description: Additional specialist agents beyond the default roster (e.g., 'regulatory_specialist', 'performance_specialist')

CodebaseSettings.description: Controls codebase analysis for integration into existing packages

path.description: Absolute path to the target package codebase

KnowledgeBaseSettings.description: Connections to internal knowledge stores (vectorstore and/or SQL) for system-specific context during synthesis, debate, validation, and scaffold

name.description: Unique identifier for this knowledge base source

description.description: What this knowledge base contains and when agents should query it

vectorstore_provider.description: Vector store provider (required when type is 'vectorstore')

vectorstore_index.description: Index or collection name in the vector store

embedding_config.description: Embedding model configuration for vector store queries

provider.description: Embedding provider. 'openai' requires an API key; 'ollama' uses a local Ollama server.

model.description: Embedding model name. Defaults: openai → 'text-embedding-3-small', ollama → 'qwen3-embedding:0.6b'.

api_key_env.description: Environment variable containing the API key (openai provider only).

ollama_base_url.description: Base URL for the Ollama server (ollama provider only). Overrides OLLAMA_BASE_URL env var.

top_k.description: Number of results to return per vector search

sql_connection_env.description: Environment variable containing the SQL connection string

env_credentials.description: Environment variable name for API credentials (empty if no auth needed)

query_templates.description: Predefined query templates for SQL sources

query.description: SQL query with $1, $2, etc. positional parameters

parameters.description: Parameter names corresponding to positional placeholders

query_mode.description: 'proactive': agents check KBs before making decisions. 'on_demand': agents only query when they identify a specific unanswered question.

base_dir.description: Base directory for all pipeline artifacts

project_name.description: Optional subdirectory for this run's artifacts
